## Fixes

- Updated to Windows App SDK 2.6.5, which fixes garbled drawing on PCs with several graphics adapters or monitors, windows turning transparent on Windows 10, and a crash when closing the app.

Choose the x64 download for Intel or AMD PCs. Choose ARM64 only for Windows on ARM devices.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/bpbp-boop/resesh/compare/v0.31.1...v0.31.2)
